email_body:
Dear Easyfairs Talent & Management Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Learning Internship at Easyfairs. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, and a strong interest in AI and emerging technologies, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to The Academy Online and help create engaging learning experiences.

In my current roles, I build and optimize websites, create digital content, and use AI tools to automate workflows. I have experience with WordPress, Canva, and video editing, and I enjoy turning complex topics into clear, accessible content. I am proactive, organized, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with international teams.

I am fluent in English and eager to learn new tools like Articulate Rise 360 and Adobe Premiere Pro. I am available for an internship of at least 12 weeks and would welcome the chance to bring my creativity and technical skills to your digital learning projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Easyfairs.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Easyfairs Talent & Management Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Digital Learning Internship at Easyfairs. As a digital marketer with a technical background and a passion for creating engaging digital content, I am drawn to the opportunity to contribute to The Academy Online and help shape learning experiences for employees across Europe.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I have developed a strong skill set in content creation, web development, and AI-powered tools. I have built and optimized websites using WordPress, created SEO-driven content, and used generative AI to streamline workflows. My experience with Canva and video editing has honed my eye for visuals and structure, and I enjoy transforming complex information into clear, interactive content. For example, I recently built a multi-page website for a youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve search visibility—a project that required both creativity and attention to detail.

What excites me most about this internship is the emphasis on experimentation and real project ownership. I am curious about AI for learning and eager to explore tools like Articulate Rise 360 and Adobe Premiere Pro. I am organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with international teams. My fluency in English and basic Dutch, combined with my technical skills, position me to contribute effectively to your digital learning initiatives.

I am available for an internship of at least 12 weeks and would welcome the chance to bring my creativity and technical skills to Easyfairs. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital content creation: experience in SEO content writing, video editing, and using Canva for visuals, with a focus on clear and engaging communication.
• AI and automation: daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research and content creation, prompt engineering, and Python automation to streamline workflows.
• Web and CMS: built and managed WordPress sites, including e-learning-friendly structures, with attention to detail and user experience.
• International collaboration: worked remotely with clients and teams across countries, fluent in English, with basic Dutch.
• Proactive and organized: self-started freelance projects, managed multiple client sites, and delivered results independently while meeting deadlines.
